note: Model parameters, not statistics. Values come from docs/state-model.md unless marked "assumption", which means the author should review them. Tune with tools/simulate.mjs.

careerEventFireRate.note: How often a career event fires in a given year, 23 to 25.

jobSearchRate.note: Chance per year of landing a job while searching.

partTimeHoursPerWeek.note: Hours for part-time jobs during college. 20 is the threshold state-model.md uses for completion odds.

nonCompleterDebtShare.note: Share of projected debt a student who leaves without finishing carries.

minAnnualGrowth.note: Floor for Scorecard-derived salary growth, some of which is negative.

loanInterestRate.note: Needs the federal Direct Loan rate with a source. Until then, repayment is modeled with no interest.
